top_changes: Show hoop-lap versus NFL-rush small multiples for 2-3 flagged names plus one film-style description (Hampton or Johnson).
Simplify the selection result to one headline test; re-chosen-measure CI [-0.30, 0.21] and 2025 flat; state evidence is weak.

judge-football.justification: Usable: names real day-3 players with film order and frozen 2026 rule, but effect small (R2 0.10 to 0.16) and 2026 list not yet available. Difficulty: handles draft slot, edge vs interior, snap load, club effects, single-rep reliability, forking paths; not man/zone or injuries; 2025 flat. Unique: drill-to-game lean mechanism, rush-level model, frozen preregistered test beyond public audits. Terminology: mostly sound; g lean in hoop vs rush, corner turn label and roster-listed stance proxy are loose; Table 2 cues from play logs not film.

top_changes: Replace best-of-6 headline with pre-registered composite or ridge/Bayesian-shrunk model over all six measures; report nested leave-one-class-out R2 gain with CI.
Fit one joint hierarchical pressure model (rush-level binomial, random rusher intercept, Hoop G x own-lean), leave-one-class-out, with measurement-error correction for 0.43 reliability.
Quantify 2025 flat result (+0.6): class-heterogeneity posterior/prediction interval for 2026; per-class placebo permuting Hoop G within class and role.
judge-datascience.justification: Spot-checks reproduced via independent verify.py: leave-one-class-out Hoop G slope +2.30 [0.75, 3.83], n=77, matching Table 1 (+2.3 [0.7, 4.0]) and per-class slopes 2.8, 3.5, 0.6. 69% day-3/UDFA share of 118 DL recomputed. numbers.json consistent with text. 11-minute analysis.py not re-run. Strong design for n~77: pick+role baselines with NGS, 10-yd split, 3-cone; LOCO with bootstrap CIs; year-standardized; reliability 0.43; forking paths handled (best-of-6 shuffle p, FWER/FDR over 41 tests, frozen 2026 rule with power). Innovation high: centripetal-lean (v2/r) metric, rush-level mixed model, rule-based tape cue. Weaknesses: nested R2 gain +0.06 [-0.30, 0.21], nested slope +1.6 [-0.7, 3.6]; 2025 flat (+0.6); club-resampling p=0.30; day-3 rank corr CI includes zero; top-third hit rate ties pick order 9/15; rank corr with NFL bend 0.14; own-lean x Hoop G touches 0; R2 gain modest 0.10 to 0.16 on n=77.

top_changes: Rewrite title and first paragraph: plain statement with number, n=77 and action in first 80 words; move caveats below bullets.
Cut statistical machinery from body (selection reruns, shuffle/fold rows, Chance-it-is-luck column, FWER detail) to Table A1; condense mechanism's four intervals.
Define Hoop G in one coach-repeatable sentence; move g formula, 0.62 g vs 0.18 g and 2.7x radius to a note; diversify Table 2 cues.

judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes (1,958 words, 5 figures, 3 tables). Structure near finalist pattern with meaningful headings and honest tone. Weak: result not in first 80 words in scout language; Run-the-Hoop Lean is jargon; lede spends second paragraph on caveats; Hoop G definition via speed-squared-over-radius; statistical machinery in body; mechanism section stacks four intervals; Table 2 cue column repeats the same phrase on four rows; validation section mixes Outcome/Test/The one test inline.

judge-viz.justification: 5 figures + 3 tables = 8 exhibits. Colourblind-safe (Okabe-Ito), large text, 95% intervals with n. Accurate: no truncated axes, chance band and shuffle nulls shown, weak rows flagged in Fig 2 title. Fig 1 tracking-native, shared yard scale and lean colour scale. Weaknesses: Fig 1 title (look alike) mismatches table; Fig 4C legend collides with a bar; Figs 2, 3B, 4A/B, A1A all forest-plot style, lacking small multiples for mechanism.
